scope.repository_search: entire checked-out repository excluding .git, node_modules, dist, and generated review patch

repository_evidence.finding: EDP, recheck, and paper-plan records explicitly carry tradingPermission=false; they are candidate/shadow observations, not a frozen execution decision source.
Forward snapshots are emitted with tradingPermission=false and unavailable scorer status; no immutable EAP_GRANTED decision is produced.
Persistence rejects production permission enablement and stores append-only shadow records; it is not a production permission ledger.
Watcher captures EDP/recheck observations but has no explicit execution-permission observer or immutable EAP decision key.
The Task-007D observer accepts an externally supplied immutable decision and fail-closes absent/malformed input; it does not connect to a real production source.
